newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican ex-state governor arrested - source.
newsitem.headline: Mexican ex-state governor arrested - source.

text.p: A former ruling party governor of Veracruz state was arrested in Mexico City on Tuesday, a police source said.

Dante Delgado Rannauro, who defected from the long-ruling Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI) several weeks ago to join a small left-wing splinter party, was arrested "for a federal crime," the source said, just hours after the Comptroller's Office charged him with tax avoidance.
The source gave no other details.

The Comptroller's Office, in a statement carried by government news agency Notimex, said Delgado would be barred from public office for 10 years because of discrepancies in his tax returns for the years 1993-1996.
It found he had committed "a grave fault by omitting to declare his assets in a truthful and timely way" and had broken federal laws governing disclosure of finances by government officials.
